adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, in embed_controller.rb line 15, when topic_id is nil, it enqueues a job with `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)`. The throttling logic is in TopicRetriever (lib/topic_retriever.rb) which checks `retrieved_recently?` using Redis setnx. However, the job is enqueued BEFORE any throttling check happens - the throttling only occurs when the job executes. This means every request to the embed endpoint with a cache miss will enqueue a new job, even if the same URL was just requested. Under high traffic to the same embed URL, this could flood the job queue with redundant jobs before the first one completes and sets the Redis key. The finding correctly identifies that throttling happens inside the worker, not at the controller level where the job is enqueued.
